doc.summary: Attempts to add the samples from the given file read with FFmpeg to the cache. Do not use this for storing lengthy audio, stream the files instead.
doc.returns:
A
if the clip was added to the cache. Null if the file doesn't exist, if it couldn't be read, or if the duration exceeds .
doc.remarks: If an entry already exists, it will be overwritten. Audio is automatically converted to player-compatible samples.
